pm_exper_user_3194_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.all_options:
(a) As part of the Singapore International Film Festival, there’s an opening-night gala premiere of *Whispers of the City*, a cross-cultural art film with only a single public showing before its festival tour — tickets are limited, so this could be your earliest chance to see it.
(b) The Projector is hosting an advance screening of the award-winning indie drama *Before the Dawn*, with a live Q&A with the director afterward — it’s three weeks before its general release, so you could catch it on the big screen before almost anyone else.
(c) Next Friday, Golden Village will have a one-night-only IMAX premiere of *Eclipse Over Glass*, a visually striking sci-fi epic that critics are already calling a feast for the senses — perfect if you want to be among the first to experience it in full cinematic scope.
(d) This weekend, local cinemas will screen a special marathon of the *Galactic Voyage* trilogy ahead of next month’s new installment — a nostalgic treat for longtime fans and a great way to revisit the saga on the big screen with fellow enthusiasts.
